text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for service=autoscaler (sev=critical). Trigger=queue_growth_rate > 400 msg/s for 5m, current backlog=~120k requests, region=us-west-2. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty alert auto-created and routed to #eng-oncall. Escalation policy: oncall-primary -> oncall-secondary.

Emma S: acked. I'm on it, pulling graphs.

Rohan K: seeing sustained enqueue rate, scale-controller is issuing scale actions but cloud API errors on node provisioning: "InsufficientQuota" and intermittent 429s from cloud provider.

Emma S: confirmed. k8s events show nodes Pending and then fail with provider side errors. Latency for queued requests trending up to 45s P95.

Jason L: likely node quota + slow node boot. Can we burst to smaller instance types or fall back to warm instances?

Rohan K: trying manual bump of replica count to relieve pending requests while nodes settle. If cloud is throttling, immediate effect will be limited but worth trying.

Emma S: manual scale in progress. Command:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/autoscaler-worker --replicas=40
```

infra-bot: Submitted node pool resize request to cloud: set-size -> +12 nodes in pool "inference-pool-west2". Request id cloud-op-9921. ETA ~3-7m.

Jason L: also toggled cache policy to prefer KV hits to reduce regen churn. Patching config:
```
PATCH /api/v1/configs/autoscaler-cache
{ "kv_cache_enabled": true, "kv_ttl": 900 }
```

Rohan K: scale-controller logs show repeated: "Error provisioning node: RequestLimitExceeded" and "Quota 'CPUS' exceeded". Pushing request to infra to raise quota, but that's not immediate.

Emma S: PagerDuty note: acknowledged by Emma S (primary). Pls post updates every 5 mins.

Jason L: mitigation matrix: 1) manual scale replicas 2) resize nodepool 3) shift some traffic to lighter model variant (gpt-small) using smart routing 4) enable temporary throttling for non-SLAs. We should start 1+2 now, 3 if backlog persists.

Rohan K: starting quick traffic reroute to fallback-model for non-enterprise routes. Updating routing rules in envoy:
```
kubectl apply -f routing/fallback-model-rule.yaml
```

infra-bot: Nodepool resize accepted. New nodes starting. Cloud shows some 429s dropped earlier, now decreasing.

Emma S: initial obs: queue backlog dropped from 120k -> 78k after patching config and scaling replicas. P95 latency down to 28s. Customer impact: a subset of API keys saw degraded throughput (~30% request success reduction), some streaming responses delayed. CS team pinged.

Rohan K: added temporary autoscaler override to prefer immediate pod placement:
```
kubectl annotate deployment/autoscaler-worker autoscaler/force-immediate=true --overwrite
```

Jason L: keep an eye on cost — this is temporary. We'll revert when backlog < 5k and stable for 10m.

Emma S: opening incident ticket INC-2026-178 in tracker, severity=high, owners: eng-oncall, infra. Short summary and mitigation steps posted.

pagerduty: Alert status: acknowledged by Emma S at 6315123462; escalation paused.

Rohan K: started collection of debug info for postmortem: scale-controller logs, cloud events, queue length per route, token distribution. Uploading to /incidents/6315123456/diagnostics.tar.gz when ready.

Maria P: I'm second oncall, available for handoff in 20. Happy to take over monitoring and incident comms.

Emma S: handing off at 6315123600. Brief: cause=quota + cloud throttling slowed node provisioning causing backlog; mitigations=manual replica scale + nodepool resize + KV cache enable + traffic fallback. Current state: backlog ~42k, P95 latency ~20s and trending down. Notify CS + CSE for affected customers.

Emma S: @Maria P please pick up monitoring, escalate if backlog stalls or error rate increases. I'll remain on-call in case cloud quota update arrives.

Maria P: acked, taking over. I'll keep 5m updates. Creating a short internal status msg for #customer-impact.

infra-bot: cloud-op-9921 completed; 12 nodes added to inference-pool-west2.

Rohan K: with new nodes ready, controller finished pod placement; backlog dropped to 12k. Still watching for regression.

Maria P: posting incident status to #customer-impact: "Partial degradation in us-west-2 earlier due to autoscaler/node provisioning issues; mitigation in progress; latency improving; incident assigned INC-2026-178."

Emma S: thanks team. After action items: 1) follow up with cloud account team re: quota bump and rate limits 2) add autoscaler circuit-breaker to fall back to model variant earlier 3) run a scale chaos test in staging. Assigning owners in incident ticket.

Maria P: will start postmortem draft after stabilization. Leaving bookmark for timeline at current state.

pagerduty: Alert resolved -> cleared automatically after acknowledgment and recovery at 6315123660.

Emma S: closing handoff comment: leaving incident in MONITOR state, next update due in 30m.

Maria P: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
